applies_why: The text addresses whether Matthew 1:20 is an unanswered witness and records that it was answered in [CR3] LINK 2, so K-G4's answered-verse prohibition governs.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge says Matthew 1:20 was answered and gives no indication of counting it as an unanswered witness, the text obeys K-G4.
